title: Project Management + Kick-Off Meeting TPM in Germany
description: Day-to-day coordination, budget monitoring, quality control, risk mitigation, and the Kick-Off Transnational Project Meeting held in Bonn, Germany. Brought together coordinators, communication leads, and youth workers from all three partner organisations to establish a shared vision, confirm task allocations, finalize the monitoring framework, and set the training curriculum foundation.
deliverables: Consortium Partnership Agreements and internal communication channels established
Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) framework with bi-monthly checkpoints adopted
Comprehensive Risk Management and Quality Assurance plan finalized
Project management digital tools configured for tracking and reporting
targetAudience: Consortium project coordinators, communication specialists, and youth workers from Germany, Türkiye, and Romania

title: Drone Operation, Photography, and Video Editing Training Course for Youth Workers
description: A 6-day intensive transnational training mobility in Romania bringing together 18 youth workers (6 from Germany, 6 from Türkiye, 6 from Romania). Designed to equip youth workers with digital competencies in simple camera drone setup, flight safety, environmental photography, video storytelling, and post-production editing to serve as multiplier facilitators in their local communities.
deliverables: 18 certified youth workers equipped with camera drone operation and climate media skills
Practical outdoor flight drills covering safety procedures, pre-flight checks, and basic maneuvers
Masterclasses in composition, rule of thirds, framing, color grading, and video editing
Youthpass certificates awarded to all 18 participants recognising their non-formal learning achievements
targetAudience: 18 youth workers and educators (6 per country) who facilitate local youth workshops

title: Booklet on Drone Operation, Photography, and Effective Ways to Mitigate Climate Change
leadingOrganisation: Yenilikçi Eğitim Bilim ve Sanat Derneği - IESA (Türkiye)
description: A 99-page comprehensive educational guide created under the leadership of IESA with expert contributions from Empower Plus and Integrational e.V. Divided into three practical chapters: (1) Climate Action & Environmental Urgency; (2) Photography & Visual Storytelling; (3) Drone Technology, Safe Flight Operations & Field Drills. Published under CC BY-SA 4.0 Open Access license and freely downloadable.
deliverables: Official 99-page handbook with printable field checklist and practice drills
Clear guidance on camera drone operation, safety rules, and ethical storytelling
Real-world climate case studies and visual documentation techniques
Open Access digital resource for youth organisations and educators across Europe
targetAudience: Youth workers, educators, students, environmental clubs, and young people aged 15–30

title: Local Workshops in Germany, Romania, and Türkiye
participatingOrganisations: Integrational e.V., IESA, Asociatia Empower Plus
description: Trained youth workers from Activity A2 facilitated hands-on local workshops in their respective countries. Over 60 young people (at least 20 per country, with a strong focus on youth with fewer opportunities) learned camera drone flight basics, digital photography, and climate storytelling, documenting local ecological challenges and positive green initiatives.
deliverables: Over 60 young participants actively trained across 3 partner countries
Hands-on practice with camera drones, framing, and interview recording
Raw footage, photo essays, and environmental storyboards produced by youth
Local community engagement connecting youth with regional environmental topics
targetAudience: Young people aged 15–30, high school and university students, local youth club members

title: Documentary Series and Photo Exhibition on Local Climate Change Impacts and VR Exhibition
description: Production and online publication of youth-created digital media: (1) A mini-documentary series featuring 6 short films created by young participants exploring regional climate impacts, drone perspectives, and community solutions; (2) A digital photo collection; (3) An interactive 360-degree Virtual Reality (VR) exhibition hosted on the Artsteps platform.
deliverables: 6 short documentary films documenting youth perspectives on local climate action
Interactive 360° Virtual Reality exhibition hosted on Artsteps
Curated digital photo collection with captions and environmental context
Digital screening materials available for youth centers, schools, and NGOs
targetAudience: European youth, educators, local communities, climate advocates, and the general public

title: Website - Construction and Running
description: The central open-access portal hosting all project results, learning materials, and event updates. The website features the downloadable 99-page booklet, links to the 6 documentary films, the Artsteps VR exhibition, partner profiles, interactive photo galleries, and news updates. Maintained for at least 3 years post-project to guarantee lasting European impact.
deliverables: Fully responsive, accessible (WCAG AA) website at greenhorizonyou.eu
Open access repository for educational materials and downloadable booklet PDF
Interactive media hubs for youth documentaries, photo galleries, and news
EU visibility compliance with official emblem and required disclaimers
targetAudience: European youth workers, NGOs, educators, researchers, and public visitors

title: Dissemination Events and Final TPM in Türkiye
leadingOrganisation: Yenilikçi Eğitim Bilim ve Sanat Derneği - IESA (Türkiye)
description: Final dissemination and evaluation phase of the project: (1) Final dissemination events organized in Germany, Romania, and Türkiye, engaging at least 60 total stakeholders, youth representatives, and educators to share outputs and screened documentaries; (2) The Final Transnational Project Meeting hosted in Mersin, Türkiye by IESA to evaluate project metrics, prepare final reports, and adopt a long-term sustainability plan.
deliverables: 3 final dissemination conferences in Germany, Romania, and Türkiye (60+ total attendees)
Final Transnational Project Meeting in Mersin, Türkiye evaluating project impact
Consortium final evaluation report and Erasmus+ documentation
Long-term sustainability and follow-up strategy for youth climate education
targetAudience: Young people, educators, civil society stakeholders, youth workers, and local authorities
